methodology.label: Methodology
methodology.title: How do we calculate impact?
methodology.subtitle: In line with our transparency principle, we share our entire impact calculation method openly.
methodology.sourcesText: FAO (2011) Global food losses and food waste; WRAP (2021) The food we waste; IPCC AR6 (2022) Food system emissions data. Methodology details and annual reports are published in our transparency documents.

steps.title: Rescued product weight is measured
steps.desc: The amount of food rescued is calculated using content information entered by the business for each Surprise Bag and average weight values.

steps.title: CO₂e conversion factor is applied
steps.desc: The rescued weight is multiplied by food-category CO₂e emission factors sourced from FAO and WRAP.

steps.title: Impact is reported
steps.desc: Every user and business can see cumulative impact data in their profile. Annual reports are shared with the public.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: You don't have to register without asking your questions first

items.question: What should I put in a Surprise Bag?
items.answer: You can put in any type of food that is fresh and consumable at the end of the day. Bread, sweets, sandwiches, hot food, grocery items... The only rule: it must be safe and consumable. You don't have to specify the contents — being a 'surprise' is part of the product.

items.question: How does the commission work?
items.answer: Rescued charges a small platform commission on the sale price of each bag sold. This commission rate varies by category and is displayed clearly in your business panel after registration. The net profit on products that would otherwise be thrown away is still much higher.

items.question: How many bags can I sell per day?
items.answer: As many as you like. You set the daily quantity limit yourself — you can start with 1 bag and scale to hundreds. Update in real time from your business panel.

items.question: Who is responsible for food safety?
items.answer: It is the business's responsibility to ensure products comply with food safety standards. Your existing food business licence remains valid. Rescued requires that only safe, consumable products are listed — this is a platform rule.

items.question: When are payments made?
items.answer: Payments are transferred to your account weekly. You can track real-time sales and revenue in the business panel.

items.question: How long does registration take?
items.answer: The online registration form takes about 5 minutes. Our team reviews your application within 24–48 hours, and after approval your business panel becomes active. You can list your first bag the same day.

items.question: Do I set the price?
items.answer: Yes, but there is a minimum discount rule: a Surprise Bag must be priced at least 50% below the normal market value of its contents. This rule protects Rescued's promise to users. Most businesses launch with a 60–70% discount and sell out quickly.

items.question: Is the panel hard to use?
items.answer: The panel is kept extremely simple. Create a bag, enter a quantity, set a time window — that's it. Mobile and tablet-friendly, no technical knowledge required. Our support team is always ready to help with the initial setup.

SSSPage.userFaqsTitle: About the App and Surprise Bags

faqs.question: What is a Surprise Bag?
faqs.answer: A Surprise Bag is a rescue bag that brings you local businesses' unsold but perfectly fresh and consumable end-of-day products at a great discount. The contents change every day — that's part of the fun.

faqs.question: Where can I pick up a bag?
faqs.answer: Once you download the app and grant location permission, you can see all active Surprise Bag businesses near you on the map. Just reserve the bag you want and head to the business at the stated time.

faqs.question: Will I know in advance what's in the bag?
faqs.answer: The general category (bakery products, sweets, ready meals, etc.) and possible contents are listed. But the exact contents change every day — that's the flavour of the surprise and the discovery.

faqs.question: Are there allergens?
faqs.answer: Businesses are required to state key allergen information (gluten, dairy, eggs, nuts, etc.) in their profile. If you have a serious allergy, you can contact the business directly before making a reservation.

faqs.question: Is payment secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. All payments are processed securely through the Rescued infrastructure. Your card details are not shared with the business.

faqs.question: Can I cancel a bag?
faqs.answer: If you cancel at least 2 hours before the collection time, you receive a full refund. The refund policy for later cancellations is detailed in the app.

faqs.question: What if the business is closed?
faqs.answer: In that case a full refund is made and our support team will notify you. Businesses with recurring reliability issues are removed from the platform.

faqs.question: How many bags can I get?
faqs.answer: Currently each user can get 1 bag per day from a business. This rule ensures the opportunity is shared fairly with the community.
